{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check the distribution of species across rows with and without missing flipper_length_mm
print('Rows with missing flipper_length_mm:\n', df[df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull()]['species'].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of species with missing sex data
print('\nRows with missing sex:\n', df[df['sex'].isnull()]['species'].value_counts())"}
